metadata.question: From January to mid-May, did Jaén a few miles east of Córdoba recieve more than 3 inches of rain fall in 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use ERA5-Land monthly aggregated precipitation (mm) for January–May 2023 over Jaén province (roughly the city and surroundings). 2. Masking: ERA5-Land is a re-analysis, no cloud mask needed; just sum total precipitation for the 5 months. 3. 3 inches = 76.2 mm. After summing, if value is None/NaN → C3; if sum ≤ 0 pixels (won’t happen for ERA5) → C2; if sum > 76.2 → A, else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time jaen = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.789, 37.779]) # Jaén city era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR') \ .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-05-16') \ .select('total_precipitation') if era5.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No ERA5 images 2023 Jan–mid-May.") print("C1") # 2. Sum precipitation (m) and convert to mm total_m = era5.sum().multiply(1000) # m → mm count = total_m.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=jaen.buffer(5000), scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('total_precipitation').getInfo() val = total_m.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=jaen.buffer(5000), scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('total_precipitation').getInfo() if val is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") print(f"2023 Jan-midMay rain: {val:.1f} mm, Pixels: {int(count)}") print("A" if val > 76.2 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
jaen = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.789, 37.779])  # Jaén city
era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR') \
         .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-05-16') \
         .select('total_precipitation')

if era5.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No ERA5 images 2023 Jan–mid-May.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 2. Sum precipitation (m) and convert to mm
total_m = era5.sum().multiply(1000)  # m → mm
count = total_m.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=jaen.buffer(5000),
    scale=10000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('total_precipitation').getInfo()

val = total_m.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=jaen.buffer(5000),
    scale=10000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('total_precipitation').getInfo()

if val is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"2023 Jan-midMay rain: {val:.1f} mm, Pixels: {int(count)}")

print("<answer>A</answer>" if val > 76.2 else "<answer>B</answer>")
